zh: 还在弄／还没决定好（此处指还在看菜单）
sentence: No, I'm still working on it.

zh: 可以为您点单了吗（餐厅固定说法）
sentence: May I take your order?
Does it come with coke and fries?

zh: 我就要……（点单／做选择时的固定说法）
sentence: I'll go with the spaghetti and meatballs, salad and the wine.
I'll just go grab a burger across the street.

zh: 事实是／问题就在于（用来反驳对方）
sentence: I understand that, but the fact is we're understaffed.
The economy is bad, and it's too risky to take on new staff.

chunk: take some of the weight off my shoulders
sentence: She would take some of the weight off my shoulders.
She could give me a hand with some of these projects and we could keep our costs down.
We could keep our costs down.

chunk: let me see what I can do
zh: 我看看能想什么办法（不明确承诺的委婉说法）
sentence: That sounds reasonable... let me see what I can do.

zh: 但有个问题／有个附带条件
sentence: There is one catch, though.

chunk: give one hundred and ten percent
sentence: I'm gonna need everyone to give one hundred and ten percent today.

zh: 搞定这个项目／着手处理
sentence: I know that together we can tackle this project.

zh: 话虽如此／说完这些（转折过渡语）
sentence: That being said, let's get to work!

zh: 我们已经把图纸过了一遍
sentence: Now, remember, we've been over the plans, but we really need to make sure that everything is up to code.
We really need to make sure that everything is up to code.
And remember the carpenter's rule of thumb: measure twice and cut once.
Do me a favor and help me cut this two-by-four, will ya?
Pass me the circular saw, and grab hold of the end of the board.

zh: 对自己的活儿有点追求／以自己的工作为荣
sentence: Geez...you gotta take pride in your work!
Pass me the sander and I'll take care of it.
